name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement a quantum kernel in PennyLane: use
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Implement a quantum kernel in PennyLane: use angle embedding on 3 qubits, compute the kernel matrix K(x1,x2)=|<phi(x1)|phi(x2)>|^2 for 6 random 2D points via the adjoint trick, and verify K is symmetric with unit diagonal. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
